ambiguities: A: the Solar catalogue nodes recorded in the saved 375:10889 snapshot (sets 478:70334…, variants 478:70344…, category frame 478:68250) are NOT FOUND in the live file. The plan therefore exports each icon from its screen element (Figma layer names such as 'Outline / Video, Audio, Sound / Play Circle' confirm style/category/name). If the owner wants catalogue-sourced artwork, current node ids of the Iconography page are needed.
B: 5:26 itself is not readable directly ('invalid node selection'); its artwork is reachable only through instances (I1280:10517 etc.), so the export node is an instance.

B: 20 of the 24 elements do NOT use 5:26; they show icon groups defined inside the parent card component (1548:31118/31123/31127/31132/31160). Groups are unnamed — no semantic icon names exist in Figma.

B: the same group shows different artwork ids on PDP V1 vs Mobile PDP (and 1171275312 differs within Mobile PDP), i.e. per-instance overrides (likely colour/state); exported per distinct artwork id to stay exact.

A/B: screen colour — library-normalised Solar files use currentColor; whether each screen element's colour equals its container's text colour is not observable read-only. Option A+ exports the screen elements themselves to capture exact colour (see plan).
